A Deep User Interface for Exploring LLaMa
Divya Perumal & Swaroop Panda
Northumbria University
Abstract. The growing popularity and widespread adoption of large
language models (LLMs) necessitates the development of tools that en-
hance the effectiveness of user interactions with these models. Under-
standing the structures and functions of these models poses a significant
challenge for users. Visual analytics-driven tools enables users to explore
and compare, facilitating better decision-making
